blocks.text: CHICAGO — Jordan Hawkins scored a season-high 19 points, Buddy Hield had 17 and the Chicago Bulls got 63 points off the bench as they held on to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 122-108 in the NBA on Monday night. Matas Buzelis added 15 points — all in the first half — as Bulls coach Tiago Splitter spread out playing time after a 151-145 overtime loss to Denver on Sunday. Tre Jones finished with 16 points and nine assists as six Bulls players reached double figures. Chicago shot 45.8% from the field and hit 20 of 49 from 3-point range. Donovan Mitchell […]...
